s1.syndrome_frame: asymptomatic breast abnormality with chronic inflammatory infiltrate
salient_findings: new 1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast on mammography
marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils
no discrete abnormality on targeted breast ultrasonography
key_facts: 48-year-old woman
no breast symptoms
routine screening mammography
1.4-cm developing asymmetry in the inner quadrant of the right breast
asymmetry persisted on craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views
targeted breast ultrasonography showed no discrete abnormality
tomosynthesis-guided vacuum-assisted biopsy performed
12 core specimens obtained
histologic examination revealed mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate
inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, with lymphocytes and plasma cells
no granulomata
patient asymptomatic
no history of urticaria, asthma, angioedema, or pruritus except for seasonal allergic rhinitis
peripheral blood eosinophil levels within normal range

raw.rationale: The histologic examination revealed a mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils, which is consistent with eosinophilic mastitis, and the patient's asymptomatic status and lack of systemic eosinophilia also support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Idiopathic granulomatous mastitis
rejected.why: The histologic examination revealed no granulomata, which is a key feature of idiopathic granulomatous mastitis

rejected.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
rejected.why: There is no mention of malignant cells or other features suggestive of cancer in the histologic examination

rejected.label: Chronic inflammatory breast disease
rejected.why: While the patient has a chronic inflammatory infiltrate, the specific diagnosis of eosinophilic mastitis is more precise and better explains the eosinophilic predominance

rejected.label: Sclerosing lymphocytic lobulitis
rejected.why: The histologic examination did not mention sclerosing features or a predominance of lymphocytes

rejected.label: Lymphocytic lobulitis
rejected.why: The inflammatory infiltrate is mixed and not predominantly lymphocytic

rejected.label: Periductal mastitis
rejected.why: While the infiltrate is periductal, the presence of eosinophils and the clinical context better support a diagnosis of eosinophilic mastitis

rejected.label: Diabetic mastopathy
rejected.why: There is no mention of diabetes or other features suggestive of diabetic mastopathy
